title: claimYieldFeeShares subtracts the full cached yieldFeeBalance instead of the claimed shares
description: Cross-function state consistency (lens A): yieldFeeBalance is a debt counter read by _totalDebt, totalYieldBalance, availableYieldBalance, liquidatableBalanceOf and transferTokensOut. Its only decrementing writer, claimYieldFeeShares, mints _shares but zeroes the whole balance. After a partial claim the unclaimed fee entitlement leaves totalDebt, so the backing assets become available yield and can be liquidated by the liquidation pair to the prize pool. The fee recipient permanently loses the remainder.

harm.loses_what: unclaimed fee shares left after a partial claim
harm.magnitude: yieldFeeBalance - _shares per partial claim (e.g. 900 of 1000 fee shares lost to prize pool)

exploit_trace: 2. yieldFeeRecipient calls claimYieldFeeShares(100): 100 shares minted, yieldFeeBalance set to 0.
3. totalDebt drops by 900 relative to the correct value; 900 assets of backing are now counted as available yield.
4. liquidationPair liquidates that yield; the recipient can never claim the remaining 900.

preconditions.text: yieldFeeBalance > 0 and recipient claims fewer shares than the balance

audit_trail.step_execution: Gates: A=✓ B=✓ C=✓ D=✓ E=✓ F=✓ G=✓ H=✓

verdict.reason: Survived gates A-H. Read PrizeVault.sol claimYieldFeeShares (lines ~611-622): `yieldFeeBalance -= _yieldFeeBalance` subtracts the cached full balance while only _shares are minted; _totalDebt = totalSupply + yieldFeeBalance so totalDebt drops by (yieldFeeBalance - _shares) with no asset outflow, which flips to availableYieldBalance and is liquidatable via transferTokensOut. No other writer restores yieldFeeBalance; no guard prevents partial claim. Not in README/bot known issues. PoC recommended.
